note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting improvements.
title: Annual rate of people affected by storms
subtitle: The total number of people affected is the sum of those injured, requiring assistance, and left homeless. Rates are measured per 100,000 people. Storms include tornadoes, hailstorms, thunderstorms, sandstorms, blizzards, and extreme wind events.
